text: In 1968, the Indecent Publications Tribunal in New Zealand ruled Walter's My Secret Life indecent except in the hands of people over 18 whose professional or academic studies covered its subject. In 1976, the Tribunal again ruled the book indecent under the same exception.
meta_description: My Secret Life by Walter: ruled indecent in New Zealand in 1968 and 1976, except for people over 18 with professional or academic interest.
changes: Restated the two rulings; exception stated once in full, once by reference.
